# Module reference

<!-- Generated by ModuleDocs from the modules' own settings. Do not edit by hand.
     ModuleDocsTest fails when this file and the code disagree, and rewrites the file as
     it fails, so the fix is to run the tests and commit the result. -->

Every module also has the shared settings `enabled`, `keybind`, `keyModifiers`,
`showInHud`, `favorite` and `lastUsed`, which are not repeated below.

**UNTESTED** marks a module that has never been exercised in a running game. It compiles and
its logic is unit tested; nobody has confirmed it behaves correctly in Minecraft.

52 modules across 6 categories; 30 marked UNTESTED.

## Combat

### Aura

Attacks the best valid entity in range using global and module target filters

| Setting | Default | Values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostile` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Allow hostile mobs |
| `passive` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Allow non-hostile living mobs |
| `animals` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Allow creature-category animals |
| `ignoreTeams` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Protect scoreboard teammates |
| `ignoreCreative` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Protect creative-mode players |
| `ignoreSleeping` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Skip sleeping entities |
| `ignoreArmorStands` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Skip armor stands |
| `ignoreNamedMobs` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | Skip custom-named non-player mobs |
| `ignoreNpcLike` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | Skip players absent from the player list (heuristic, may hide real players) |
| `rotation` | `NONE` | `NONE\|CLIENT\|SMOOTH` | Optional visible aim assistance through the shared rotation service |
| `rotationSpeed` | `180` | `1..720` | Smooth rotation speed in degrees per second |
| `maxYawStep` | `45` | `1..180` | Maximum yaw movement per tick |
| `maxPitchStep` | `30` | `1..90` | Maximum pitch movement per tick |
| `returnRotation` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | Restore starting view on release if the user has not moved it |
| `range` | `4.2` | `1..6` | Maximum attack range when the target is visible |
| `wallsRange` | `3` | `0..6` | Maximum range for targets without line of sight; 0 disables wall hits |
| `fov` | `360` | `1..360` | Horizontal target field of view in degrees |
| `players` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Allow player targets after the global target policy |
| `mobs` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Allow non-player living targets after the global target policy |
| `ignoreFriends` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Never target players in the local friend list |
| `ignoreInvisible` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Skip invisible targets |
| `pauseOnUse` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Pause while using an item |
| `onlyOnClick` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | Only attack while the attack key is held |
| `vanillaCooldown` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Use Minecraft's normal fully-charged attack timing |
| `delay` | `10` | `0..40` | Custom delay in ticks when vanillaCooldown is off |
| `priority` | `closest` | `closest\|lowest_health\|highest_health\|lowest_armor\|angle\|crosshair\|hurt_time\|recent_attacker` | How valid targets are prioritized |
| `switchDelay` | `8` | `0..60` | Ticks a chosen target is kept even when another ranks higher; 0 always takes the top-ranked one |
| `maxTargets` | `1` | `1..8` | Spread attacks across this many targets, one per landed hit; 1 is ordinary single-target behaviour |

### Trajectories

Predicts held projectile flight paths using vanilla-aware launch physics

| Setting | Default | Values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `physics` | `Vanilla` | `Vanilla\|Custom` | Vanilla uses item-family launch speed, bow charge and source movement; Custom uses the values below |
| `steps` | `100` | `10..300` | Number of simulation steps to render |
| `powerScale` | `1` | `0.25..2` | Multiplier applied after the vanilla/custom launch speed is resolved |
| `includePlayerMotion` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Add the player's known movement to the predicted launch like vanilla shootFromRotation |
| `gravity` | `0.05` | `0..0.2` | Custom-mode vertical gravity per simulation step |
| `drag` | `0.99` | `0.8..1` | Custom-mode velocity multiplier per simulation step |
| `onlyWhenUsing` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | For instant-use throwables, only show a path while the use-item key is held |
| `collision` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Stop the prediction at the first block or living-entity collision |
| `landingMarker` | `true` | `true/false or on/off` | Draw a marker at the predicted impact point |
| `markerSize` | `0.22` | `0.05..1` | World-space impact marker radius |
| `red` | `255` | `0..255` | Path red channel |
| `green` | `220` | `0..255` | Path green channel |
| `blue` | `80` | `0..255` | Path blue channel |
| `rainbow` | `false` | `true/false or on/off` | Cycle this module's colour through the hues |
| `rainbowSeconds` | `4` | `0.5..60` | Seconds for one full colour cycle |
